placeholders.@<entry key>: In a set's server `entry`: the catalog entry id of the entry whose key is that (the file name under entries/), looked up in the catalog once a person approved a version of it.
placeholders.@approved: In a set's server `version`: the newest approved version of the entry that server names (`v1`, `v2`, ... for remote and command entries, the exact package version for npm). Never a draft, a revoked or a deprecated one.

prerequisites.what: The gitea-mcp binary at /usr/local/bin/gitea-mcp in the workspace image (images/workspace/Dockerfile), pinned to a release and checked against that release's checksums file. Not done: it needs its own ticket and an image rollout. Until then the entry can be approved but every server reports a failed start.

entries.reason: One reviewed gitea-mcp for the three Gitea instances (git.isnan.me, git.konfersi.com, git.kohi-labs.com): the `gitea` server of each program set names its host and its own token file. D-8: Gitea stays the git host.
Project documents on docs.isnan.me through Outline's own MCP endpoint.
Konfersi's documents on outline.int.konfersi.com (internal host, private network allowed) through Outline's own MCP endpoint.
Kohilabs' documents on outline.int.kohi-labs.com (internal host, private network allowed) through Outline's own MCP endpoint.

OPTIONAL draft, not published by the default publish (D-8: Gitea is the git host, GitHub only a mirror): GitHub-hosted projects and the GitHub mirror, read-only by default, with lockdown on. To use it, set publish to true in a reviewed commit.
Reference only: the Browser pool (cpb-browser) delivers it. See REVIEW.md.
